== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Shepherds are members of the Consultants' Guild{{!}}Consultant Guild, a group dedicated to serving The Empire{{!}}the Empire and its Emperor with absolute loyalty. Dressed in black clothing and often wearing masks, they function as specialists in reconnaissance, observation, and infiltration rather than combat. Their training is rigorous, requiring trainees to master skills such as scaling structures, navigating complex environments like sewers, and performing long-duration surveillance with perfect memory retention. While they are highly skilled at gathering accurate information, they are not trained as assassins and can be ineffective in direct physical confrontations. Within the guild's hierarchy, there is a High Shepherd who oversees their operations and represents the group in political matters.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Shepherds serve as a group of guards and lookouts, with one member notably being found crumpled in black against a wall. This group includes an individual who lunged for [[Shera]]'s ball, and a third person was eventually identified as belonging to their ranks. During her journey, [[Shera]] interacted with the group when a Shepherd provided her with a Calder's captain’s horn{{!}}captain's horn. Additionally, she borrowed a gun from one of the Shepherds.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A Shepherd was found crumpled in black on the wall.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Shepherds act as lookouts and guards.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A third person was identified as a Shepherd.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15" />}}</li>
